## ValueTypeConstructors.record() method

A record with exactly `fields`<!-- -->. Undeclared fields are rejected in both directions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
record<const Fields extends RecordFields>(fields: Fields, options?: ValueTypeOptions): ValueType<RecordSdk<Fields>>;
```

## Exceptions

`TypeError` when a field is neither a value type nor an optional field, or is a `none` type.

## Remarks

A required field must be present and not `undefined`<!-- -->; `null` is allowed only when its type is nullable. An optional field that is absent (or holds `undefined`<!-- -->) is omitted from the wire, and a decoded record has no own property for it. A present `null` stays an own property holding `null`<!-- -->.
